name: my-flappy-aljo
description: A fun little Flappy Bird-style game

scripts.build: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path www) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force www }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path www; Copy-Item index.html, game.js, utils.js, render.js, particles.js -Destination www; Copy-Item -Recurse src, Tools -Destination www"
